card.what: Moulded nylon piston hank, 50 mm, for 6.4 mm (1/4 in) forestay wire: a J-shaped hook round the stay, a spring-loaded brass piston that closes its mouth, and a split tail screwed through the jib's luff
card.boats: every hank-on jib: the J/22's jib on its forestay (about 8 to 9 hanks; class boats often carry bronze hanks), and later the fleet's small keelboats. Not placed by a layout yet: the jib is FSailCloth in the game
card.distance: arm's reach on the foredeck when hoisting or dropping the jib; the cockpit camera sees them in a row up the stay
card.before: the J/22 hero proof of concept's hank (Inputs/j22-hero/build_j22_hero.py): a plain 28 mm bronze cylinder with a 16 mm pin on it; the kit had no hank

references.use: the target look: white nylon body, brass piston and knob, two screws in a split tail (three-quarter view, so proportions only roughly)
references.url: Bean's hardware reference sheet, Nov 8 2026 (project upload, middle row, fourth: 'Jib Sail Hank'); a third party's catalogue picture, for looking at only

references.use: a moulded white hank on a luff: hook curl, rounded tip, screw through the tail, soft moulded edges
the same hank seen from the hook end with the sail flat: the hook's plane stands square to the sail, the screw goes through the sail
in use: a bronze piston hank on a forestay, the hook round the wire and the piston level with the luff

references.note: nylon piston hank for 6.4 mm (1/4 in) wire: 50 mm (2 in) long, UV-stabilised nylon body, brass piston, screws included, 8 g (Defender, Vela Sailing Supply listings)

sizes.name: Overall length, hook front to tail
Height across the hook and body

features.text: J-shaped hook curling round the stay to a rounded tip
The eye takes 6.4 mm wire with room to slide (inside at least 7.5 mm)
The mouth opens wider than the wire when the piston is back, and the piston closes it
Brass piston across the mouth, seated in the tip
Brass thumb knob on the piston's aft end, a flat-topped cap a thumb can pull
Split tail: two cheeks with the luff in the slot between them
Two screws through the cheeks, heads on one side and nuts on the other
A rounded window in the body's flank where the brass piston shows
One moulding with soft fillets, no seams between hook, body and tail
White nylon body, brass piston and knob, stainless screws

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles. A jib carries 8 or 9: the light copy is what the game would draw up the stay
